name.value: Sutton Place Hotel Revelstoke Mountain Resort

description.value: The Sutton Place Hotel Revelstoke Mountain Resort is an upscale suite-style hotel situated at Revelstoke Mountain Resort, offering apartment-style suites ranging from studios to three-bedroom units, many with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and mountain-view balconies. It operates year-round in a premier ski and outdoor recreation destination in the Columbia Mountains, with on-site dining across multiple venues including Rockford Bar & Grill and La Petite Baguette. Touring cyclists arriving in Revelstoke would find comfortable, self-contained accommodation with easy access to the town's services.

raw_osm.name: Sutton Place Hotel Revelstoke Mountain Resort

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the property is a real, operating luxury hotel at Revelstoke Mountain Resort with active bookings for the 2026/27 season. The amenities page confirms complimentary Wi-Fi, in-suite laundry (washer/dryer present in all suite types), USB charging ports in rooms, and multiple on-site dining venues. No mention of bike-specific amenities (secure bike storage, e-bike charging, tools, pump, or bike wash) appears anywhere in the website content; the 'ski lockers' mentioned in the resort fee description are ski-specific and cannot be assumed to serve cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating luxury hotel at a major BC resort destination with active bookings; clearly useful to touring cyclists needing accommodation in Revelstoke.

Laundry.detail: In-suite washer/dryer included in all suite types as confirmed across room listings

Nearby evening food.detail: Multiple on-site dining venues listed: Rockford Bar & Grill, Revelation Lodge, Mackenzie Common Tavern, La Petite Baguette, plus room service

Device charging.detail: USB Charging Ports listed as a suite feature in room amenity descriptions
